customManagers.description: nixpkgs commit the Attic client comes from: the nixos-unstable head
Nix release. NIX_SHA256_AMD64 and NIX_SHA256_ARM64 are not updated: fixed by hand in the pull request
yamllint, run by the lint job (pipx run yamllint==<version>)

packageRules.description: The daily nixos-unstable bump: merged by GitHub's auto-merge once the required checks (lint, build (amd64), build (arm64): master ruleset) passed

prBodyNotes: ⚠️ `NIX_SHA256_AMD64` and `NIX_SHA256_ARM64` are not updated by Renovate, and the build fails until they are: take the `x86_64-linux` and `aarch64-linux` hashes from https://releases.nixos.org/nix/nix-{{{newVersion}}}/install (`curl -fsSL https://releases.nixos.org/nix/nix-{{{newVersion}}}/install | grep -B1 -E 'nix-{{{newVersion}}}-(x86_64|aarch64)-linux'`) and push them to this branch.
